description: Provincial  public Services Commission - Western Province - Order pertaining to the delegation of power of the  Western  Provincial Public Service under the  Section 32 (2a) of the provincial Councils Act No. 42 of 1987 as amended  by the Provincial Councils (Amendment)  Act No. 28 of 1990
reasoning: This gazette notification pertains specifically to public service administration within the Western Province. It deals with the delegation of powers for appointment, transfers, promotion, dismissal, and disciplinary control of provincial public service officers. The content focuses on public sector personnel management and administrative procedures, falling clearly under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) which cover public service recruitment, transfers, disciplinary matters, and administrative instructions for government employees.
